elements.content: Grammar focus: Near-Native Information Packaging & Focal Adjustments.

Core Rule: Align information flow from Given (Theme) to New/Focused (Rheme) using syntactic shifts: extraposition, fronting, passive conversions, and heavy-NP postposing.

End-Weight Postposing — Move heavy NP to sentence end: The committee postponed a comprehensive, multi-layered audit into systemic fiscal irregularities .
Fronting for Topic Linkage — Front prepositional phrase / complement: Central to this debate lies the principle of national sovereignty.
Passivization for Focus — Object -> Subject conversion: The unprecedented policy shift was endorsed by all twenty-seven member states.
Guided practice: choose the correct option.
1. Which sentence applies end-weight principle to position heavy information at the end?
options: The CEO presented to the shareholders a detailed five-year strategy for international expansion.
A detailed five-year strategy for international expansion the CEO presented.

elements.content: 2. What is the primary function of information packaging in C2 English?
options: To align sentence theme and rheme for maximum clarity and rhetorical focus
